tools.name: list_worlds
tools.description: Public Jetopolis worlds open right now: name, server region, pace (Standard: 1 game day = 20 real minutes, Blitz: 5), start and end year, current game date and era, players and seats, players active in the last 24 hours, and a link to open the world. Worlds never pause.

tools.name: get_world
tools.description: One Jetopolis world by id: the same card as in list_worlds plus finishedAt for a world that has ended.

tools.name: world_standings
tools.description: Player airlines of a world ranked by rating: airline name and two-letter code, home base, rating, aircraft in service, open routes, founding date, status and a link to the public airline card. tools.name: historical_airlines
tools.description: Real airlines that operated in a given year (1950-2030) as the game knows them: name, IATA code when reliably known, home country and region, type, years of operation, and the countries each one served that year.
